The US economic strangulation of Cuba has created unbearable hardships for the population. @medeabenjamin  dscribes what she saw on a recent solidarity delegation and how we can break the blockade. Watch now on The Chris Hedges Report.

Link: piped.video/watch?v=JzWMouhv…

The Reality Behind the 'Ceasefire' in Iran (w/ Alastair Crooke)
piped.video/watch?v=-HWepHPz…

Amidst the US-Iran negotiations, Alastair Crooke says, Iran is not incentivized to end the war. Instead, it seeks to upend America's hegemonic dominance of the region — and "break the paradigm." Watch us discuss on the latest ep. of The Chris Hedges report.

Link: piped.video/watch?v=_RKEjfID…

Col. Larry Wilkerson says that in order for the US to win the war in Iran, it needs a "spectacular victory," while Iran just needs to not lose. With Trump in power, however — he is doubtful a peaceful end to the war can occur.

Col. Lawrence Wilkerson details how the Iran War is actually about something under discussed by most media — the Cold War with China.

Trita Parsi (@tparsi) discusses the likely consequences of Trump's seemingly inevitable escalation in Iran — and the powerful forces that appear to be pushing him in that direction. We discuss on the latest episode of The Chris Hedges Report. 

Link: piped.video/watch?v=dUyJubRB…

As the U.S. seeks to label Iran as a mass sponsor of state terrorism, CIA whistleblower @JohnKiriakou looks inward, examining the decades of US-backed terror campaigns waged towards imperialist ends.

LinkL piped.video/watch?v=5Ulb8-Qo…
Watch my full interview with Max on this subject now: piped.video/watch?v=XQGnWJ8l…

.@MaxBlumenthal answers whether Trump's fear of assassination was the primary factor in driving him to wage war in Iran. 

Blumenthal asks: "What does Donald Trump think about Charlie Kirk’s assassination? Who does he think did it? I know people around Trump have serious questions about that one as well. But watching Charlie Kirk get shot in the neck in the middle of a rally was probably not received well by Trump."

The Palestinian epic "Palestine 36" is more than a dramatization of the past. It maps the early blueprint for Palestine’s occupation, and captures the struggle of the present. Watch director Annemarie Jacir and I discuss the film on the latest episode of The Chris Hedges Report. 

Link: piped.video/watch?v=12wXnP03…
